spans.s: Hindurāja-suratrāṇa (IE 8-2), title assumed by some of the Vijayanagara kings, adopted from the Muslim royal title Sult̤ān. See Suratrāṇa, Hindurāya-suratrāṇa.
Hindurāya-suratrāṇa (Ep. Ind., Vol. I, p. 363), title of the Vijayanagara kings, Suratrāṇa being the same as Arabic Sult̤ān. See Hindurāja-suratrāṇa.
hīni (CII 1), same as Sanskrit hāni; loss or diminution.
